identity.title: Who it runs as
identity.body: Everything in a box runs as the user {{user}} (uid {{uid}}, gid {{gid}}), never as root. The build hook is the one exception: it runs as root while the image is built.

storage.title: What is kept
storage.body: Only {{path}} is kept across deploys and rebuilds. It is the box's workspace, a volume of this service. Anything else in the container is replaced at every deploy.

ide.title: How the IDE is reached
ide.off: The browser IDE is turned off, so nothing can open this box's files.
ide.no_token: The browser IDE is on, but no token exists yet, so nothing can get in.
ide.expired: The browser IDE's token has expired, so nothing can get in until a new one is issued.
ide.open: The browser IDE is open to whoever holds its token, for the workspace's files and nothing else.
